name: com.digopolis/digopolis
title: Digopolis
description: Real museum artifacts: search archaeology finds, artifact of the week and a calm dig game.

tools.name: search_artifacts
tools.description: Search Digopolis, a free archaeology site and game built only from real museum records (The Met, Rijksmuseum van Oudheden and other open collections): excavated objects (date, culture, material, findspot, museum), excavation sites (Lisht, Malqata, Nimrud, Dura-Europos, Gerasa, Nijmegen...), cultures and periods (Middle Kingdom Egypt, Neo-Assyrian, Sasanian, Roman) and archaeology words explained (stratigraphy, faience, ostracon). Returns facts copied from the record and a link with the photo.

query.description: Object, site, culture or word, e.g. "scarab", "Nimrud", "Roman glass", "stratigraphy"

tools.name: artifact_of_the_week
tools.description: One real excavated object every week (changes on Monday), with its museum record: what it is, when and where it was made, where it was found and which museum keeps it. Use for a history or archaeology fact of the week, a class warm up or a newsletter.

tools.name: archaeology_game
tools.description: Digopolis: a calm free archaeology game in the browser with real objects from open museum collections. Dig real excavation sites layer by layer, brush and sieve the soil, mend broken pots, date and identify finds in a lab and build your own museum over months; a daily Mystery Artifact for everyone. Use when someone wants an archaeology or history game for kids, a class or adults.
